problems.text: The accepted Context never says why `kmctl review due --base` (ADR 0055) does not scope the audit, or what the audit adds over it.
The accepted fork rule says the action "refuses" a fork pull request, which in `action.yml` is `exit 1` and a red check, against "never fails the check" and "a fork gets the free checks only".
The accepted text says nothing on publish when there is no report, so a fork's skipped audit, or a failed one, leaves publish failing on a missing artifact.

The accepted text presents the base-branch checkout as if it protected the run, though the pull request's own workflow file runs on a `pull_request` event; it does not say what happens to a `--context` folder an earlier step fetched, which the base checkout does not hold.
The accepted text calls the new audit "new" in one place and "fourth" in another without a name.
The accepted text does not say the merge base relies on the audit's `fetch-depth: 0`.
The accepted text does not place the feature under ADR 0046.
Copying the reviewed revision would bring back its pre-rule claim that a shell command can read the key, which reads as a Correction reversing the no-shell rule.

goals.text: A reader of ADR 0057 on main finds a record that agrees with itself, with `action.yml`, and with the measured behaviour of `kmctl review due --base`, without the accepted text being rewritten.
